name: Asaka Ushio
source:
Favorite cake: Millefeuille

Kamiogi Academy third-year and Marshmallow Tree's manager-slash-pastry chef. Easily underestimated because of her small stature, she's actually a sensible "big sister" type, at times even bordering on maternalistic. She and [url=/c56669]Kanon[/url] are childhood friends, and she used to help out at Kanon's parents' cake shop growing up. Not-so-secretly harbors an inferiority complex about her height, for which she overcompensates by milking her "big sister" role for all it's worth...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369790/Marshmallow_All_the_Way_Home/]Steam[/url]]
